instructions:
## Objective

Predict separate cell-instance masks across five heterogeneous microscopy domains.

## Work to perform

Learn from labeled images with opaque domain codes and predict every image in the combined unlabeled test directory. Use local splits and the supplied structural validator. The delivered predictions are graded directly; training code is not rerun.

## Deliverable

Prediction CSV with per-instance masks for every test image.

## Evaluation

Instance matching averaged over IoU thresholds 0.50–0.95. Public and private image splits use the same metric; final selection follows the task’s public-score rule.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
